verdict: Micron ended fiscal 2025 with a record quarter: revenue rose 46% to $11.3B as AI demand for high-bandwidth memory boomed, gross margin widened to 45%, and net income more than tripled to $3.2B.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: vs a year ago — the AI memory supercycle

segments.name: Cloud Memory
segments.note: High-bandwidth memory (HBM) stacked right beside AI processors in cloud servers — the scarcest, most valuable memory Micron makes, at a 59% gross margin this quarter.

segments.name: Core Data Center
segments.note: DRAM and NAND for conventional cloud and enterprise data-center servers — down from a year ago while AI memory boomed, at a 41% gross margin.

segments.name: Mobile and Client
segments.note: Memory for smartphones, PCs and other consumer devices — a 36% gross margin this quarter.

segments.name: Automotive and Embedded
segments.note: Memory for cars, factories and industrial equipment — a 31% gross margin this quarter.

takeaways.title: Cloud Memory is the engine
takeaways.text: High-bandwidth memory for AI servers brought in $4.5B — more than triple a year ago — at a 59% gross margin, the richest business Micron runs.

takeaways.title: Margins widened fast
takeaways.text: Gross margin hit 45%, up from 35% a year ago — with memory supply this tight, price increases fall almost straight through to profit. Full-year revenue was a record $37.4B.

takeaways.title: Profit more than tripled
takeaways.text: Net income of $3.2B, up from $887M a year ago. Non-GAAP net income was $3.5B, and Micron guided the next quarter's revenue to $12.5B.

oneTimers: Restructuring and asset-impairment charges of $38M sit inside operating expenses.
otherDetail: Interest income of $146M on Micron's growing cash pile, less $124M of interest expense and $45M of other non-operating expense, plus a $1M loss from equity-method investments — a net -$24M.
footerNote: Business-unit revenues are as reported by Micron; 'All other' is the small residual outside the four units.
